props.name: title
props.description: A descriptive title for the panel

props.name: description
props.description: When provided, a description is displayed below the title

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Function that will be called when the panel is closed

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Function that will be called when the selection is submitted

props.name: onClearSelection
props.description: Function that will be called when the clear selection is selection

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: Useful for defining an external anchor

props.name: open
props.description: If defined, will control the open/closed state of the panel.

props.name: width
props.description: Sets the width of the Dialog, pick from our set list of widths, or pass `auto` to automatically set the width based on the contents. `small` corresponds to `256px`, `medium` corresponds to `320px`, `large` corresponds to `480px`, `xlarge` corresponds to `640px`, `xxlarge` corresponds to `960px`.

props.name: height
props.description: Sets the height of the `Dialog`, pick from our set list of heights, or pass `fit-content` to set the height based on the contents. `xsmall` corresponds to `192px`, `small` corresponds to `256px`, `medium` corresponds to `320px`, `large` corresponds to `432px`, `xlarge` corresponds to `600px`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback when input text changes, use this for search/filter

props.name: loading
props.description: Useful for subtle loading states while fetching items asynchronously
